description: Fix: Docker API container crash-loop caused by bind mount overwriting container node_modules (tsx MODULE_NOT_FOUND)

userStories.title: Add anonymous volumes to protect node_modules in compose.yml
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Docker API container to preserve the node_modules installed during image build so that the bind mount of the host workspace does not overwrite them with Windows-incompatible binaries.
acceptanceCriteria: In infra/docker/compose.yml, under the api service volumes, add anonymous volume entry '/app/node_modules' after the bind mount
No other service or setting in compose.yml is changed
userStories.notes: Anonymous volumes added to compose.yml api service: /app/node_modules and /app/apps/api/node_modules

userStories.title: Replace pnpm exec with pnpm run dev in api.Dockerfile
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the API Dockerfile CMD to use 'pnpm run dev' instead of 'pnpm exec tsx watch src/index.ts' so that binary resolution is delegated to pnpm and works correctly inside the Linux container.
acceptanceCriteria: In infra/docker/api.Dockerfile, the CMD in the dev stage is changed from ["pnpm", "--filter", "@evennotes/api", "exec", "tsx", "watch", "src/index.ts"] to ["pnpm", "--filter", "@evennotes/api", "run", "dev"]
No other stage or instruction in api.Dockerfile is changed
userStories.notes: CMD changed from pnpm exec tsx watch src/index.ts to pnpm run dev in api.Dockerfile dev stage

userStories.title: Verify Docker API container starts healthy
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to confirm that 'pnpm docker:up' no longer produces a crash-loop on api-1 and that the healthcheck passes after applying the two infrastructure fixes.
acceptanceCriteria: Running 'docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml down -v' followed by 'pnpm docker:up' completes without MODULE_NOT_FOUND errors in api-1 logs
web-1 container starts successfully after api-1 becomes healthy
userStories.notes: FIXED — Three root causes resolved: (1) Added anonymous volumes for all packages/*/node_modules and apps/cli/node_modules in compose.yml so pnpm workspace symlinks are preserved after bind mount. (2) Changed healthcheck URL from 'localhost' to '127.0.0.1' in compose.yml and api.Dockerfile dev stage — Alpine /etc/hosts maps localhost to ::1 (IPv6) first but Node binds IPv4 only. (3) Added start_period: 30s and retries: 5 to healthcheck to tolerate tsx watch warm-up restart window. All acceptance criteria pass: no MODULE_NOT_FOUND errors, docker inspect returns 'healthy', GET /health returns 200, web-1 starts after api-1 becomes healthy, typecheck passes.
